description: Release only when req does not exceed used; rejection changes no state.

methods.name: Release
methods.header:
method Release(used: int, req: int) returns (next: int, ok: bool)
  requires used >= 0 && req >= 0
  ensures ok == (req <= used)
  ensures next == (if ok then used - req else used)
  ensures next >= 0

reference.Release:
if req > used { next := used; ok := false; }
  else { next := used - req; ok := true; }

mutants.violation: Releasing more than used creates negative occupancy.

provenance: Locally authored quota-domain diagnostic. Not a public/industrial PSM, independent external source, or held-out benchmark.
